scope: Local-only reconciliation of the three evidence-bearing Batch 03 targets to frozen generated wall runs. This is geometry/provenance evidence, not a runtime edit or module authorization.

classification_vocabulary.full_observed_side: The recorded view establishes a complete source-side chain.
classification_vocabulary.partial_observed_side: The exact source-side chain is identified, but visible coverage is broad or occluded rather than endpoint-complete.
classification_vocabulary.material_only_safe: The exact receiving chain is identified, but evidence supports only the stated homogeneous material/value field.
classification_vocabulary.unmapped: Observation-to-run ownership is not high-confidence or the face is unobserved.

validation_contract: Every generated run index appears exactly once per target and mapped/unmapped partitions cover each record.
Every endpoint, endpoint elevation and normal matches the frozen generated record; length and bearings derive from those values.
Each ownership chain reconstructs its exact frozen OSM source edge in order.
Contiguous mappings have exact endpoint continuity; Station 48 WSW facets use an explicit contiguous envelope with embedded unmapped returns.
Every mapped run passes the 85 degree resolved-viewpoint outward-facing tolerance.
Personnel Support inner courtyard runs 18..27 remain unmapped and prohibited from exterior spill.
Building 600 portal and Station 48 operational openings/modules remain blocked; fallback massing is not resolved.
